In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel molecular materials with a focus on metal-organic frameworks (MOFs).
the design, synthesis and characterization of novel metal-organic materials with interesting and useful properties.
the design of new molecular components and their assembly into dynamic metal-organic frameworks with unique properties and functions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the design of molecule L with rigid side arms and flexible core is a successful strategy for the construction of dynamic metal-organic frameworks with amphoteric behavior.
the use of the reverse design strategy, with rigid side chains and a flexible core, allows the preparation of a dynamic, amphoteric MOF that exhibits both Pd uptake and H 2 S sensing.

this work presents the synthesis of a new MOF that is capable of both Pd2+ uptake and H2 S sensing, with a soft core that allows for the uptake of metal ions, and rigid side arms that allow for the sensing of small molecules.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed an amphoteric MOF that can sense both oxidizing and reducing agents, and that can be applied to the sensing of both H2S and PdCl2.
we have designed and prepared a new class of MOFs that are capable of dynamic transformations in the solid-state, and that are capable of sensing and sequestering toxic species.

the use of rigid side arms to control the flexibility of the core in a dynamic metal- organic framework system can result in the design of materials that exhibit both amphoteric character and dynamic behavior.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of soft and rigid components within a single molecule is a viable design strategy to create dynamic MOF systems that combine the best of two worlds.
the design of MOF systems can be further extended to incorporate the reverse design, where the flexible core is surrounded by rigid arms.
a soft core and flexible side chains are an effective way to create dynamic MOF systems.
